why: Egyptian clinics need appointment scheduling, patient record keeping and prescription printing without crossing into medical-device claims.
operator: The clinic owner sees patients across morning and evening shifts. Their day is appointments, patient histories, lab requests and printing prescriptions for patients to take to a pharmacy.
entities: Clinic (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Patient (id, clinicId, name, phone, encryptedHealthData, consentWhatsApp, guardianPhone, visitsCount, lastVisit)
Appointment (id, clinicId, patientId, dateTime, duration, type, status, notes, followUpRequired)
LabOrder (id, clinicId, patientId, testType, status, resultStatus, requestedAt, collectedAt, reportedAt)
Prescription (id, clinicId, patientId, issuedAt, lines with medicineRef, dosage, notes, validUntil)
Staff (id, clinicId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: No : clinic carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Patient data is not product-based
special: The core structures are the appointment lifecycle, the encrypted patient record, the lab order tracking and the printable prescription. Patient data is special-category: encrypted, exportable on request, deletable on request.
screens: Appointment calendar: day/week view with patient names, status colours and duration slots
Patient record: name, phone, guardian phone, visit history, consent flag, encrypted health data summary
Lab order: test type, status (pending/collected/reported), result status, dates
Prescription editor: medicine list, dosage, instructions, printable layout with doctor signature
Visit summary: recap of symptoms, recommendations, follow-up dates, printable PDF
Staff shift: clock in/out, patient load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : menu, staff, reports, billing
Manager: everything except billing and export; approves leaves and overrides
Nurse: patient vitals entry, lab order entry, prescription countersign
Cashier: appointment billing, receipt printing, shift close
reports: Appointments by day and hour: utilisation and no-show rate
Patient visit frequency: returning patients, new patients per month
Lab order status: pending, collected, reported counts
Prescription volume per doctor, per period
Staff shift summary: hours worked, patient load, notes
integrations: WhatsApp deep link for appointment reminders and confirmations
Google Calendar sync for appointment reminders
onboarding: Clinic basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Specialities: the clinic's medical specialities and the staff assigned
Appointment types: the visit types the clinic offers (consultation, follow-up, check-up)
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: set up first appointment type, first patient record, first prescription format
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the appointment/patient/prescription schema and role templates.

tasks.title: Add appointment calendar screen with conflict detection
tasks.brief: Build the UI for the appointment calendar: day/week view, patient names, status colours, duration slots, no-overlap validation. Done when the calendar prevents double-booking and saves appointments to Firestore.
tasks.done: When appointment creation blocks overlapping times and persists data

tasks.title: Add encrypted patient record screen
tasks.brief: Build the patient record screen: name, phone, guardian phone, visit history, consent flag. Done when the data is stored with encryption metadata and is viewable only to role-gated users.
tasks.done: When patient record stores data with encryption and role-based access

tasks.title: Add lab order screen with status tracking
tasks.brief: Build the lab order screen: test type, status flow (pending → collected → reported), dates, result entry. Done when the status updates propagate and the audit log records each change.
tasks.done: When lab order status tracking works end-to-end with audit logging

tasks.title: Add printable prescription editor
tasks.brief: Build the prescription editor: medicine list, dosage, instructions, doctor signature, printable layout. Done when the prescription prints to ESC/POS thermal printer and renders correctly in the browser.
tasks.done: When prescription prints correctly both thermally and as browser view

tasks.title: Add WhatsApp deep link for appointment reminder
tasks.brief: Build the WhatsApp deep link that sends an appointment reminder to the patient. Done when the link opens WhatsApp with pre-filled appointment details (date, time, clinic name).
tasks.done: When WhatsApp link opens chat with pre-filled appointment info

tasks.title: Add visit summary screen with printable PDF
tasks.brief: Build the visit summary recapping symptoms, recommendations, follow-up dates. Done when the summary renders as a PDF that prints correctly from browser and thermal printer.
tasks.done: When visit summary PDF generates and prints correctly

tasks.title: Add staff shift clock in/out screen
tasks.brief: Build the shift screen: clock in/out, patient load per hour, notes. Done when clock in/out saves timestamps and the shift summary displays correct data.
tasks.done: When shift clock in/out works and summary displays correctly

tasks.title: Add appointment no-show report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing appointments by day/hour with no-show counts and rates. Done when the report pulls live data from Firestore and displays correct rates.
tasks.done: When no-show report pulls live data and displays correctly

tasks.title: Add patient visit frequency report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing returning vs new patients per month. Done when the report computes and displays the frequency breakdown from Firestore data.
tasks.done: When visit frequency report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial clinic setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: clinic basics, specialities, staff addition, first appointment type. Done when the flow completes and the clinic appears in the system with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and clinic is created

risks: Patient health data is special-category: mishandling violates PDPL
Encryption key loss makes patient records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Over-prescription risk if the system does not flag duplicate medicines
